name: bodyweight overhead squat
description: A deep squat performed with your arms locked out overhead. It trains the legs while testing shoulder and hip mobility.
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and raise both arms straight overhead.
Brace your core and keep your arms in line with your ears.
Sit your hips back and down into a deep squat, chest tall.
Drive through your heels to stand, keeping your arms locked overhead.
